title: What to order at KFC when you want to lose weight
intro: KFC is often the go-to when going out with family or on weekends. You can enjoy your favourite fried chicken without undoing your efforts. Choose the right piece, a light side and a sugar-free drink. Calories below are estimates.

best.name: Original Recipe chicken breast (skin removed)
best.why: Breast meat is high in protein. Most of the oil and batter is in the skin.

best.name: 1 Original Recipe drumstick
best.why: Small size, easy to control your portion, still satisfying.

best.name: Coleslaw (regular size)
best.why: Has vegetables and a fresh taste. A better side than wedges.

best.name: Whipped Potato (regular size)
best.why: Small portion and low in calories compared to fried sides.

best.name: Zinger without mayonnaise
best.why: If you're craving a burger, skip the mayonnaise to save calories.

careful.name: Large Hot & Spicy chicken piece with skin
careful.why: The thick, crispy batter soaks up more oil.

careful.name: Cheezy Wedges
careful.why: Fried potatoes with cheese sauce. Calories go up fast, better to share.

careful.name: Large fries
careful.why: Easy to finish without noticing, especially while chatting.

careful.name: Combo of 3 chicken pieces + wedges + regular soft drink
careful.why: Almost half your daily calories in one meal. Save it for once in a while.

hacks: Choose Original Recipe over Hot & Spicy.
Ask for breast or drumstick, and remove half or all of the skin.
Swap wedges or fries for coleslaw or whipped potato.
Order 2 pieces ala carte, not the 3-piece combo.
Swap sweet soft drinks for mineral water.
drink: Mineral water. If you want a bit of flavour, choose a sugar-free drink.

faq.q: Do I have to remove all the chicken skin?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Removing half already saves calories. If you want to eat the skin, keep it to one piece and balance it with a light side.

faq.q: Is it okay to eat KFC with my family on weekends?
faq.a: Yes, it's okay. Have 1-2 pieces of Original Recipe, coleslaw and mineral water. Enjoy your time with family and keep eating balanced on other days.
